differences.a_observable: The camera is positioned closer to the tiles, resulting in a tighter framing of the Recurly and Hyperswitch cards.
differences.b_observable: The camera is positioned further back, resulting in a wider framing where the cards appear smaller.
differences.fix: Adjust the camera's Z-position to match the closer framing of the reference video.

differences.a_observable: The white tiles have a cool blue-cyan color cast.
differences.b_observable: The white tiles are neutral white to warm cream, lacking the cool blue cast.
differences.fix: Apply a cool blue color temperature or color grading to the scene's lighting.

differences.a_observable: The lighting has high contrast with bright highlights and deep, defined shadows in the tile crevices.
differences.b_observable: The lighting is flat and diffused, with soft shadows and lower contrast.
differences.fix: Increase the contrast of the key light and reduce ambient fill to deepen shadows and enhance highlights.

differences.a_observable: The border surrounding the yellow Recurly card is dark gray.
differences.b_observable: The border surrounding the yellow Recurly card is blue.
differences.fix: Change the border color of the yellow card from blue to dark gray.

json.highest_impact_fix: Adjust the camera position to match the closer framing of the reference video, and increase the contrast and cool blue color cast of the lighting.
